answer:
Done — I imported the 30 Strava runs into your Running note as a typed table and built a running app on the App side.

It shows total distance, weekly progress against a 30 km goal, average pace/HR, weekly distance bars, monthly summary, recent runs, and a form to log new runs.

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner.
